areas.title: Law Compliance
areas.description: I study how neural networks interact with legal requirements, including copyright, data ownership, and regulations. My work examines unauthorized use of training data and neural plagiarism, as well as deriving scenario-specific requirements from traffic laws.

areas.title: Rule Compliance
areas.description: I study how domain rules can guide neural-network training and robustness evaluation. In adversarial mix-up, the traffic-flow fundamental diagram constrains sample generation, connecting adversarial training to physically meaningful traffic states.

areas.title: Physical Scenarios & Simulation
areas.description: I work on physical scenarios and simulation for learning and evaluating intelligent-system behavior. Our vehicle-dynamics work combines tire–pothole impacts, vertical vehicle dynamics, and interactions between vehicles in a closed-loop simulation environment for reinforcement learning.

areas.title: Efficient Learning
areas.description: I am interested in helping models learn with less data and computation. This direction asks how to make effective use of available information while reducing the cost of training and adaptation.

areas.title: Lifelong Learning
areas.description: I am interested in models that continue learning as tasks and environments change. The central challenge is to acquire new capabilities while retaining useful knowledge from earlier experience.
